name: plan-run-live-dogfood
description: First full live dogfood of the plan-run coordinator (plnr_sr3nx8ds688s, plan pl-116e, 6-step serial chain): POST /plan-runs with {project, planId, agent, promptTemplate ({seed_id} placeholder), providerOverride, modelOverride} walked all six children, gated each dispatch on the previous PR merging (auto-merge + gh CI), auto-closed each seed, and went terminal succeeded with zero coordinator faults. One repair run needed (CI test nondeterminism), dispatched onto the PR branch via targetBranch; total 7 runs, ~$5.20, PRs #799-#804. promptTemplate carrying 'sd show {seed_id}' + plan-show + gates-terminal instructions was sufficient — no per-step prompt customization required.

name: plan-run-child-retry
description: Automatic child retry (warren-6de9): retryable-cause list + budget predicates live in src/plan-runs/retry.ts; budget persists on plan_run_children.retry_count; retry events must be emitted on the NEW child run id because tail-events fans out over current child run ids; re-dispatch requires the running → dispatched child transition (legalized in CHILD_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS).

name: merge-stall-warning-one-shot
description: Merge-stall warning pattern (pl-92a3 step 7): the coordinator probes a stalled child PR only after the grace period (WARREN_PLAN_RUN_MERGE_STALLED_WARNING_MS, default 300000, 0 disables) measured from mergeWaitBaseline, and derives the one-shot guarantee from the persisted event stream (scan for a prior plan_run.merge_stalled, same shape as hasEmptyPushEvent) so it survives a server restart. The probe (src/plan-runs/merge-stall.ts) maps an unavailable check rollup to checksPassing:null and never warns on autoMerge:'unknown' — honest 'cannot tell' readings stay silent by contract.
